caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded stoneware jug or crock with a relatively wide, open mouth and two small, curved handles positioned on either side near the neck. The vessel is colored primarily in shades of beige and gray with areas of brown discoloration and surface staining, indicating wear or aging. The front of the jug shows a painted decoration of a blue bird perched on a twig, with its wings partially open and a smaller branch beneath it, all rendered in blue tones. A dark vertical line, possibly a crack or seam, runs from the rim to the base. The base of the vessel features a circular spout or hole. The entire jug is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Wine or Water Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
